scripts.dev:ios-simulator: cd frontend && bash scripts/setup_ios_build_dir.sh && flutter run --dart-define=USE_LAN=false
scripts.dev:ios-device: cd frontend && bash scripts/setup_ios_build_dir.sh && flutter run --dart-define=USE_LAN=true --dart-define=LAN_HOST=${LAN_HOST:-192.168.1.76}
scripts.dev:all:simulator: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ios-simulator"
scripts.dev:all:device: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ios-device"
